# Harsh Makwana

> Senior Backend Engineer, 6+ years building distributed systems and microservices. Preferred stack: Node.js, NestJS, Prisma, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, gRPC, Temporal, AWS, streaming systems — but can build with whatever a problem calls for. Currently at Simform Solutions, based in Ahmedabad, India.

## Past work

- End-to-end, sub-second-latency GPU streaming platform: on-demand GPU orchestration that spins up cost-efficient instances only for the duration of a session and streams live video straight to viewers.

## Open source

- snapflow-desktop: https://github.com/hmake98/snapflow-desktop — Electron desktop app for screenshot capture, annotation, and issue tracking, with multi-monitor support and GitHub/Zoho/cloud sync. Built using a Claude AI workflow end to end. In progress.
- nestjs-grpc: https://github.com/hmake98/nestjs-grpc — Production-ready NestJS gRPC framework with CLI type generation, connection pooling, and streaming support.
- nest-mcp: https://github.com/hmake98/nest-mcp — NestJS library for integrating Model Context Protocol servers.
- nestjs-temporal-core: https://github.com/harsh-simform/nestjs-temporal-core — NestJS integration for Temporal.io with automatic workflow discovery.
- nestjs-starter: https://github.com/hmake98/nestjs-starter — NestJS boilerplate with JWT auth, Prisma, Redis, BullMQ, Swagger, i18n.
- nestjs-microservices: https://github.com/BackendWorks/nestjs-microservices — NestJS monorepo for scalable microservices with gRPC and Kong API Gateway.
